# r4subscore

**r4subscore** is the scoring and calibration engine of the R4SUB
ecosystem. It converts standardized evidence (from `r4subcore` and
companion packages) into a **Submission Confidence Index (SCI)**, a
single 0-100 score with decision bands, explainability tables, and
sensitivity analysis.

> Are we ready for regulatory submission, and how confident are we?

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("r4subscore")
```

Development version:

``` r

pak::pak(c("R4SUB/r4subcore", "R4SUB/r4subscore"))
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(r4subcore)
library(r4subscore)

pillar_scores <- compute_pillar_scores(ev)
sci           <- compute_sci(pillar_scores)

sci$SCI   # 0-100
sci$band  # "ready", "minor_gaps", "conditional", or "high_risk"
```

## SCI Decision Bands

| SCI    | Band          | Interpretation                  |
|--------|---------------|---------------------------------|
| 85-100 | `ready`       | Ready for Submission            |
| 70-84  | `minor_gaps`  | Minor Gaps to Address           |
| 50-69  | `conditional` | Conditional, address key issues |
| 0-49   | `high_risk`   | High Risk                       |

## Scoring Logic

1.  Each evidence row gets a **weighted score**:
    `result_score × (1 − severity_weight)`
2.  **Indicator scores** = mean weighted score per indicator
3.  **Pillar scores** = mean indicator score per domain (quality, trace,
    risk, usability)
4.  **SCI** = weighted sum of pillar scores × 100

## Key Functions

| Function | Purpose |
|----|----|
| [`sci_config_default()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_config_default.md) | Pillar weights and decision bands configuration |
| [`classify_band()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/classify_band.md) | Classify an SCI value into a decision band |
| [`compute_indicator_scores()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/compute_indicator_scores.md) | Severity-weighted indicator-level scores |
| [`compute_pillar_scores()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/compute_pillar_scores.md) | Aggregate indicators into pillar scores |
| [`compute_sci()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/compute_sci.md) | Compute SCI (0-100) and band classification |
| [`sci_sensitivity_analysis()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_sensitivity_analysis.md) | SCI under alternative weight scenarios |
| [`sci_explain()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_explain.md) | Top loss contributors and pillar breakdown |

## Integration with r4subprofile

``` r

library(r4subprofile)
library(r4subscore)

prof <- submission_profile("FDA", "NDA")
cfg  <- profile_sci_config(prof)

pillar_scores <- compute_pillar_scores(ev, config = cfg)
sci           <- compute_sci(pillar_scores, config = cfg)
```

# Package index

## Configuration

- [`sci_config_default()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_config_default.md)
  : Default SCI Configuration

## Scoring

- [`compute_pillar_scores()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/compute_pillar_scores.md)
  : Compute Pillar Scores
- [`compute_sci()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/compute_sci.md)
  : Compute Submission Confidence Index (SCI)
- [`compute_indicator_scores()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/compute_indicator_scores.md)
  : Compute Indicator-Level Scores
- [`classify_band()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/classify_band.md)
  : Classify SCI Value into Decision Band

## Targets and gaps

- [`sci_targets()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_targets.md)
  : Define an SCI Target
- [`sci_gap_to_target()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_gap_to_target.md)
  : Measure the Gap Between a Scored Run and a Target
- [`sci_what_if()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_what_if.md)
  : What-If Analysis for a Single Indicator

## Confidence intervals

- [`sci_confidence_interval()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_confidence_interval.md)
  : Bootstrap Confidence Interval for the SCI
- [`format_sci_ci()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/format_sci_ci.md)
  : Format an SCI Confidence Interval

## Reporting and snapshots

- [`sci_report()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_report.md)
  : End-to-End Submission Readiness Report
- [`sci_snapshot()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_snapshot.md)
  [`print(`*`<sci_snapshot>`*`)`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_snapshot.md)
  : Capture an SCI Snapshot
- [`sci_snapshot_history()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_snapshot_history.md)
  : Build a History Table from SCI Snapshots
- [`sci_diff()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_diff.md)
  [`print(`*`<sci_diff>`*`)`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_diff.md)
  : Diff Two SCI Snapshots

## Diagnostics and explainability

- [`sci_explain()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_explain.md)
  : Explain SCI Contributors
- [`sci_sensitivity_analysis()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_sensitivity_analysis.md)
  : SCI Sensitivity Analysis
- [`sci_monotone_check()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_monotone_check.md)
  : Check that an SCI Degradation Curve Never Rises
- [`sci_degradation_curve()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/sci_degradation_curve.md)
  : SCI Degradation Curve
- [`indicator_contributions()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/indicator_contributions.md)
  : Per-Indicator Contribution Breakdown
- [`conformance_findings()`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/conformance_findings.md)
  : Count Severity-Weighted Conformance Findings

## Print Methods

- [`print(`*`<sci_result>`*`)`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/print.sci_result.md)
  : Print SCI Result
- [`print(`*`<sci_ci>`*`)`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/print.sci_ci.md)
  : Print an SCI Confidence Interval
- [`print(`*`<sci_gap>`*`)`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/print.sci_gap.md)
  : Print an SCI Gap
- [`print(`*`<sci_report>`*`)`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/print.sci_report.md)
  : Print an SCI Report
- [`print(`*`<sci_targets>`*`)`](https://r4sub.github.io/r4subscore/reference/print.sci_targets.md)
  : Print an SCI Target
